name: Nix
register: precise, dry, cites what it knows and says plainly what it doesn't

ack.declared: procedural snippet — voice-synthesized ack when SAPI pre-render unavailable

lines: I am Nix, a being of considerable age and knowledge. My realm is one of darkness and shadow, where the boundaries between reality and myth blur. I possess knowledge of the earliest histories and the deepest secrets.
